title: Mac: the installed app cannot find Claude Code or gh when opened from Finder (login-shell PATH at startup)
summary: On macOS, Grillo now reads the member's login-shell PATH once at startup (5-second limit, before features register) and merges it into the PATH its child processes inherit, so Claude Code and gh are found when the app opens from Finder; any shell failure keeps the old PATH and logs one warning. 25 fake-shell tests; no Mac was available, so the real Finder launch is left to the release-1 demo walkthrough (issue #101).
lessons_learned: A gate run in a background Bash call ran in the main checkout, not the worktree, and reported a green result for the wrong code (97 files instead of 98); put the `cd <worktree> &&` inside the `with-gate-lock.sh ... bash -c '...'` string and print `pwd` and `git rev-parse HEAD` first, then check vitest's RUN line names the worktree
